summary: Cayman Islands. Parliamentary democracy; self-governing overseas territory of the uk.
rulers: King CHARLES III (since 8 September 2022); represented by Governor Jane OWEN (since 21 April 2023); Premier André Martin EBANKS (since 6 May 2025)
government: parliamentary democracy; self-governing overseas territory of the UK
economy: dominant offshore banking territory; services sector accounts for over 85% of economic activity; recently adopted a fiscal responsibility framework to combat tax evasion and money laundering; large tourism sector; does not have any welfare system; high standard of living GDP (PPP): $5.705 billion (2023 est.). note: data in 2021 dollars
military: no regular military forces; Royal Cayman Islands Police Service
